newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends firmer.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends firmer.

text.p: White sugar futures ended firmer after the recent declines as trade players covered short positions.
"At the moment we're seeing some short covering and a bit of producer and trade buying," said a trader.
At the close most traded positions had gained ground, with December up $3.20 at the day's high of $331.50 and March up $2.10 also at $331.50.
Total volume was a solid 2,343 lots.
The advance met some speculative selling. Traders added that there was little fundamental news to spur the London market, despite Tunisia's recent spate of snap tenders.
